name: freefamilydisplay
author: Layer One IT Consultants (https://layeroneconsultants.com/)
description: Self-hosted family dashboard. Admin UI + kiosk renderer for wall displays.

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@ffd/web
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@ffd/worker
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@ffd/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build --force && tsc -p packages/log/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/crypto/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.tools.json && tsc -p apps/worker/tsconfig.test.json && npm run typecheck --workspace=@ffd/web
scripts.test: tsx --test packages/log/src/logger.test.ts packages/crypto/src/crypto.test.ts apps/web/lib/auth/auth.test.ts apps/web/lib/board/widgets.test.ts apps/web/lib/board/rotation.test.ts apps/worker/src/net/ssrf.test.ts apps/worker/src/wallpapers.test.ts apps/worker/src/connectors/ics.test.ts apps/worker/src/connectors/google-photos.test.ts apps/worker/src/connectors/folder-collections.test.ts apps/worker/src/connectors/anime-booru.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
